Name: Shoplift East Scarp
Author: TheMightyAmondee
Description:
[size=6]Shoplift East Scarp
[/size][size=3]
A content pack to allow the shops added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] to be shopliftable locations. Featuring unique dialogue for the East Scarp shopkeepers if they notice you stealing their goods.[/size]

[size=3]The shops made shopliftable by this mod include:[/size]

[size=3]- Lexi's trading post[/size]
[size=3]- The East Scarp Inn (you can be banned from this location if you're not careful!)[/size]
[size=3]- The coffee cart[/size]
[size=3]- Jessie's seed shop (if her NPC mod has been added)[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation:
[/size][/b]
[size=3]This is a content pack for Shoplifter. Shoplifter 1.2.3 or later must be installed for this mod to be used.[/size]

[size=3]1. Download the mod. It will download as a .zip file[/size]
[size=3]2. Unzip the downloaded .zip file[/size]
[size=3]3. Move the unzipped file to your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]4. Enjoy! - and don't get caught![/size]

[b][size=4]Uninstalling:
[/size][/b]
[size=3]Remove the mod from your Mods folder. Simple!

[b]Translations currently available in:
[/b]
- English by me
- Japanese thanks to hachihina!

[/size][size=4][b]See also:
[/b]
[/size][size=3]A very big thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]Lemurkat[/url] for allowing me to create this compatibility content pack for East Scarp!

Don't have Shoplifter yet? You can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8569]here[/url]![/size]
